svg.title: Water Divination · developer affinity
svg.desc: Updated 2026-10-28, Asia/Seoul. Code shares count unique committed source files in local projects; The top four languages are selected by file count, ties by name; code shares are normalized within these four. TSX counts as TypeScript; JSX counts as JavaScript. Tests included; generated output excluded. AI shares use the same retained token snapshot as the activity card; cached input included once. Code and AI use separate totals. TypeScript: 74.0%; JavaScript: 22.8%; CSS: 1.6%; Go: 1.6%; Claude: 1.7%; Codex: 98.3%
